gold_decisions.text: Lock member onboarding as: PulseMail announces the new home and links to Create your password. That link opens Northstar's password-reset screen. After they set a password they log in. Migrated members skip Northstar welcome. New applicants get Northstar welcome plus profile nudge.

assumptions.text: PulseMail copy can say Create your password even though the next screen says Reset password, as long as helper text explains the mismatch.
Northstar cannot set passwords for migrated or newly approved users. Reset is the only path.
There is no extra Northstar 'you did it' email after password set. Next step is log in. First-login nurture lives in PulseMail.

gold_decisions.text: Until native video-on-demand ships, past webinars go to a YouTube unlisted link, then either a Perspectives recap post or a separate On Demand events area. The live event page does not magically become a blog.

assumptions.text: Native VOD is not ready for this launch, so YouTube is acceptable for MVP.
On Demand can later appear as just another event type filter on the homepage.

gold_decisions.text: Go live with 1-2 discussion posts on the homepage. Perspectives (articles, playbooks, recaps, spotlights) are not the same thing as Discussions.

assumptions.text: The homepage forum widget can be limited to discussions only, not blog topics.

gold_decisions.text: Contributor and apply forms will not be native SiteBlocks forms. Apex supplies PulseMail embeds. Northstar places them on the pages and builds thank-you pages.

assumptions.text: SiteBlocks cannot store native form submissions in time for MVP.
PulseMail thank-you redirects will point at the new community thank-you pages before members use the forms.

gold_decisions.text: Public launch (invites) is Wednesday. Site can go live Tuesday for internal QA, but no member invites until field executives can SSO and the team can log in.

assumptions.text: Field executives are on the SSO allowlist and GateSSO redirect_uri includes forgex.io after domain cutover.
Member upload completes before the PulseMail send.

gold_decisions.text: Soft launch to 200-250 inactive members first. Company and social launch the next day. Second touch the day after, split active vs inactive.

assumptions.text: Apex can pull a timely list of who reset their password vs who has not, with timestamps.

gold_decisions.text: Success for roadshow days is one cohesive view: new logins, new applicants (PulseMail), event registrations. Do not make the team stitch five admin reports.

assumptions.text: Logged-in users in analytics means people who reset a password and actively logged in, excluding vendor staff.
Event registration reports exclude test events by default.
